scope: A deliberately small analytical precursor. It tests whether the proposed decision structure exists before a continuous UAV implementation is authorized.

opponent_response_rules.mirror_pressure: After observing allocation, allocate both blockers to the most defended corridor; ties resolve left.
opponent_response_rules.weak_side_denial: After observing allocation, allocate both blockers to the least defended corridor; ties resolve right.
opponent_response_rules.commitment_exploiter: After observing a sustained commitment, protect the initially uncommitted corridor; against a feint, retain the initial block and incur a repositioning lag.

hard_stop: A pass is only structural qualification. It cannot authorize method naming or PPO training until the same choices arise from a continuous, non-scripted UAV dynamics implementation under a separate N0.4 audit.
